properties.description: VPN Brute force failures - The rule alerts when failed logins from the same source IP address exceed a certain threshold
properties.query:
let TriggeredUsers =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-049 VPN Brute force Failures-1"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities)
| mvexpand A
| extend Account = A.Account
| where isnotempty(Account)
| summarize make_set(Account);
CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where SourceUserName !in( "","pre-logon")
| where SourceUserName !in(TriggeredUsers)
| where not(ipv4_is_match( SourceIP,"130.41.187.64/26"))
| where DeviceEventClassID == "GLOBALPROTECT"
| extend Activity=extract('Name=(.*?)\\;',1,AdditionalExtensions)
| extend Result=extract('outcome=(.*?)\\;',1,AdditionalExtensions)
| where Activity  in ("gateway-auth","portal-auth")
| where Result == "failure"
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),count(), makeset(SourceUserName) by SourceIP
| where EndTime - StartTime < 10m
| where count_ > 15
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
